name: pitch-deck-bootstrap
title: Pitch Deck Bootstrap
description: Single-shot 6-slide HTML pitch deck from a one-line brief. Cover → Problem → Solution → Traction → Why-now → Ask. Single file, 1920×1080, scale-to-fit, keyboard nav, print-to-PDF.

query.en: Create a {{slideCount}}-slide HTML pitch deck for {{audience}} about {{topic}}. Tone: {{tone}}. Use the canonical 1920×1080 deck framework verbatim — fill only the slide content slots. Arc: Cover → Problem → Solution → Traction → Why-now → Ask.
query.zh-CN: 为 {{audience}} 制作一份 {{slideCount}} 页 HTML pitch deck，主题：{{topic}}。语气：{{tone}}。直接复用 1920×1080 canonical deck framework，只填 slide 内容。结构：封面 → 问题 → 方案 → Traction → Why now → Ask。

exampleOutputs.title: Sample 6-slide deck (Lumen — voice AI for support)

inputs.name: topic
inputs.label: Topic / company
inputs.placeholder: e.g. Lumen — voice AI that resolves 70% of support tickets without a human
